_comment: Free sound libraries hosted on GitHub. `vs packs install <id>` sparse-clones only the audio folder and copies it into the workspace library. Add your own with `vs packs add <git-url> ...`.

uisfx.about: 936 synthesized UI/motion sounds: 78 cues (success, error, swipe, toggle, notification, loading, unlock, level-up...) in 12 sonic styles (minimal, soft, glass, studio, cinematic, scifi, arcade, organic, zen, dreamy, rubber, mechanical).

kenney-interface.about: 100 recorded interface sounds from Kenney (click, select, switch, toggle, open/close, maximize/minimize, glass, glitch, error, confirmation, drop, pluck, scratch...), with per-file licence, tags and durations.
